description: This file defines an in-memory store module for managing bookmarks and notes associated with lessons during a user session. It provides functions for subscribing to state changes, retrieving current state, toggling bookmarks, adding, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribe to store changes; returns an unsubscribe function.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the current state to prevent external mutation.

methods.name: isBookmarked
methods.description: Checks if a lesson is bookmarked.

methods.name: toggleBookmark
methods.description: Toggles the bookmark status for a given lesson.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes associated with a specific lesson.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to a lesson and returns the created note.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates the text of a specific note by ID.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from a lesson.
